description: This Java class defines the 'ThingDeletedStrategy', which handles 'ThingDeleted' events, updating the lifecycle status of a 'Thing' to DELETED within a persistence strategy context.

classes.name: ThingDeletedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractThingEventStrategy to handle 'ThingDeleted' events by marking the thing's lifecycle as DELETED.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to set the lifecycle of a thing to DELETED upon receiving a 'ThingDeleted' event.
